plot_1: relative abundance of resistant alleles vs susceptible alleles in all nematode species, per sample
```{r}
# input csv
file <- "/Users/john.archer/Documents/Glasgow/anthelmogram/final_output_data/AHG_illumina_01/AHG_illumina_01_bt-i1_merged_FILTERED_FINAL.csv"

# sample
sample_id <- "102"

# read data
df <- read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# select sample
df_s <- df %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    grepl(paste0("^", sample_id, "\\."), Sample)
  )

# keep one row per Sample × Species × Beta_codon
df_s <- df_s %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sample, Species, Beta_codon) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# make sure numeric
df_s <- df_s %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Total_depth = as.numeric(Total_depth),
    Resistance_allele_frequency =
      as.numeric(Resistance_allele_frequency),
    Susceptible_allele_frequency =
      as.numeric(Susceptible_allele_frequency)
  )

# calculate resistant and susceptible read counts
totals <- df_s %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Resistant_reads =
      sum(
        Total_depth * Resistance_allele_frequency,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    Susceptible_reads =
      sum(
        Total_depth * Susceptible_allele_frequency,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    total_reads = Resistant_reads + Susceptible_reads,

    Resistant =
      Resistant_reads / total_reads,

    Susceptible =
      Susceptible_reads / total_reads
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Resistant, Susceptible) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "status",
    values_to = "proportion"
  )

# plot
plot_1 <-
  ggplot(
    totals,
    aes(
      x = sample_id,
      y = proportion,
      fill = status
    )
  ) +

  geom_col(width = 0.7) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    labels = scales::percent
  ) +

  theme_bw() +

  labs(
    title = paste("plot_1:", sample_id),
    x = "Sample",
    y = "Allele proportion",
    fill = ""
  )
```

plot_2: relative abundance of resistant alleles vs susceptible alleles in each species, per sample
```{r}
# input csv
file <- "/Users/john.archer/Documents/Glasgow/anthelmogram/final_output_data/AHG_illumina_01/AHG_illumina_01_bt-i1_merged_FILTERED_FINAL.csv"

# define sample ID
sample_id <- "102"
df <- read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# filter to defined sample
df_s <- df %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl(paste0("^", sample_id, "\\."), Sample))

# keep one row per codon (each codon appears three times)
df_s <- df_s %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sample, Species, Beta_codon) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# ensure numeric values
df_s$Total_depth <- as.numeric(df_s$Total_depth)
df_s$Codon_allele_frequency <- as.numeric(df_s$Resistance_allele_frequency)
df_s$Susceptible_allele_frequency <- as.numeric(df_s$Susceptible_allele_frequency)

# calculate weighted allele frequencies per species
plot_df <- df_s %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    resistant =
      sum(Codon_allele_frequency * Total_depth) /
      sum(Total_depth),

    susceptible =
      sum(Susceptible_allele_frequency * Total_depth) /
      sum(Total_depth),

    total_reads = sum(Total_depth),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

# summary table
summary_table <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    prop_species = total_reads / sum(total_reads)
  )

print(summary_table)

# remove species contributing <1% of reads
plot_df <- summary_table %>%
  dplyr::filter(prop_species >= 0.01)

# melt
plot_long <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Species,
    resistant,
    susceptible
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(resistant, susceptible),
    names_to = "status",
    values_to = "proportion"
  )

# plot
plot_2 <-
ggplot(plot_long,
       aes(x = Species,
           y = proportion,
           fill = status)) +

  geom_col(width = 0.8) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0,1),
    expand = c(0,0)
  ) +

  theme_bw() +

  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = paste("plot_2:", sample_id),
    x = "Nematode species",
    y = "Allele frequency",
    fill = ""
  )
```

plot_3: relative abundance of resistant alleles vs susceptible alleles at each codon position in all species, per sample
```{r}
# input
file <- "/Users/john.archer/Documents/Glasgow/anthelmogram/final_output_data/AHG_illumina_01/AHG_illumina_01_bt-i1_merged_FILTERED_FINAL.csv"

# define sample ID
sample_id <- "102"
df <- read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# filter to selected sample
df_s <- df %>%
  filter(grepl(paste0("^", sample_id, "\\."), Sample))

# keep one row per sample × species × codon
df_s <- df_s %>%
  group_by(Sample, Species, Beta_codon) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

# ensure numeric
df_s$Total_depth <- as.numeric(df_s$Total_depth)
df_s$Codon_allele_frequency <- as.numeric(df_s$Resistance_allele_frequency)
df_s$Susceptible_allele_frequency <- as.numeric(df_s$Susceptible_allele_frequency)

# calculate species abundance
species_totals <- df_s %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(
    total_reads = sum(Total_depth),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    prop_species = total_reads / sum(total_reads)
  )

# remove species contributing <1% of reads
keep_species <- species_totals %>%
  filter(prop_species >= 0.01) %>%
  pull(Species)

df_s <- df_s %>%
  filter(Species %in% keep_species)

# calculate weighted allele frequencies for each codon
plot_df <- df_s %>%
  group_by(Beta_codon) %>%
  summarise(
    Resistant =
      sum(Codon_allele_frequency * Total_depth) /
      sum(Total_depth),

    Susceptible =
      sum(Susceptible_allele_frequency * Total_depth) /
      sum(Total_depth),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Susceptible, Resistant),
    names_to = "allele",
    values_to = "proportion"
  )

# tidy codon labels
plot_df$Beta_codon <- factor(
  plot_df$Beta_codon,
  levels = c("codon167", "codon198", "codon200"),
  labels = c("167", "198", "200")
)

# plot
# library(scales)
plot_3 <-
ggplot(plot_df,
       aes(x = Beta_codon,
           y = proportion,
           fill = allele)) +

  geom_col(width = 0.7) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +

  labs(
    title = paste("plot_3:", sample_id),
    x = expression(beta*"-tubulin codon"),
    y = "Allele frequency",
    fill = "Allele"
  ) +

  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

plot_4: relative abundance of resistant alleles vs susceptible alleles at each codon position, per nematode species, per sample
```{r}
# input csv
file <- "/Users/john.archer/Documents/Glasgow/anthelmogram/final_output_data/AHG_illumina_01/AHG_illumina_01_bt-i1_merged_FILTERED_FINAL.csv"

# define sample ID
sample_id <- "102"
df <- read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# filter to selected sample
df_s <- df %>%
  filter(grepl(paste0("^", sample_id, "\\."), Sample))

# keep one row per sample × species × codon
df_s <- df_s %>%
  group_by(Sample, Species, Beta_codon) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

# ensure numeric
df_s$Total_depth <- as.numeric(df_s$Total_depth)
df_s$Resistance_allele_frequency <- as.numeric(df_s$Resistance_allele_frequency)
df_s$Susceptible_allele_frequency <- as.numeric(df_s$Susceptible_allele_frequency)

# calculate species abundance
species_totals <- df_s %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(
    total_reads = sum(Total_depth),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    prop_species = total_reads / sum(total_reads)
  )

# filter species contributing <1% of reads
keep_species <- species_totals %>%
  filter(prop_species >= 0.01) %>%
  pull(Species)

df_s <- df_s %>%
  filter(Species %in% keep_species)

# resistant abundance
df_resistant <- df_s %>%
  transmute(
    Species,
    Beta_codon,
    status = "Resistant",
    abundance = Resistance_allele_frequency * Total_depth
  )

# susceptible abundance
df_susceptible <- df_s %>%
  transmute(
    Species,
    Beta_codon,
    status = "Susceptible",
    abundance = Susceptible_allele_frequency * Total_depth
  )

# combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(df_susceptible, df_resistant)

# calculate proportions within each species × codon
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(Species, Beta_codon, status) %>%
  summarise(
    abundance = sum(abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Species, Beta_codon) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = abundance / sum(abundance)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# order species by abundance
species_order <- species_totals %>%
  filter(Species %in% keep_species) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_reads)) %>%
  pull(Species)

plot_df$Species <- factor(plot_df$Species,
                          levels = species_order)

plot_df$Beta_codon <- factor(
  plot_df$Beta_codon,
  levels = c("codon167","codon198","codon200"),
  labels = c("167","198","200")
)

# plot
plot_4 <-
ggplot(plot_df,
       aes(x = Species,
           y = proportion,
           fill = status)) +

  geom_col(width = 0.8) +

  facet_wrap(~Beta_codon, nrow = 1) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0,1),
    expand = c(0,0)
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +

  labs(
    title = paste("plot_4:", sample_id),
    x = "Nematode species",
    y = "Allele frequency",
    fill = ""
  ) +

  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

plot_5: relative abundance of each specific resistance mutation vs susceptible alleles, at each codon position, in all species, per sample
NOTE: does not yet show 'undefined' mutations
```{r}
# input csv
file <- "/Users/john.archer/Documents/Glasgow/anthelmogram/final_output_data/AHG_illumina_01/AHG_illumina_01_bt-i1_merged_FILTERED_FINAL.csv"

# define sample ID
sample_id <- "102"
df <- read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# filter to selected sample
df_s <- df %>%
  filter(grepl(paste0("^", sample_id, "\\."), Sample))

# keep one row per sample × species × codon
df_s <- df_s %>%
  group_by(Sample, Species, Beta_codon) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

# ensure numeric
df_s$Total_depth <- as.numeric(df_s$Total_depth)
df_s$Codon_allele_frequency <- as.numeric(df_s$Resistance_allele_frequency)

# calculate species abundance
species_totals <- df_s %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(
    total_reads = sum(Total_depth),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    prop_species = total_reads / sum(total_reads)
  )

# remove species contributing <1% of reads
keep_species <- species_totals %>%
  filter(prop_species >= 0.01) %>%
  pull(Species)

df_s <- df_s %>%
  filter(Species %in% keep_species)

# define mutation
df_s <- df_s %>%
  mutate(
    Mutation = ifelse(
      Protein_change_all == "NA",
      "Susceptible",
      Protein_change_all
    )
  )

# resistant allele frequency belongs only to resistant mutations
df_resistant <- df_s %>%
  filter(Mutation != "Susceptible") %>%
  transmute(
    Beta_codon,
    Mutation,
    abundance = Codon_allele_frequency * Total_depth
  )

# susceptible abundance
df_susceptible <- df_s %>%
  transmute(
    Beta_codon,
    Mutation = "Susceptible",
    abundance = Susceptible_allele_frequency * Total_depth
  )

# combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(df_susceptible, df_resistant)

# sum across species
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(Beta_codon, Mutation) %>%
  summarise(
    abundance = sum(abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# convert to proportions
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(Beta_codon) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = abundance / sum(abundance)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# order codons
plot_df$Beta_codon <- factor(
  plot_df$Beta_codon,
  levels = c("codon167","codon198","codon200"),
  labels = c("167","198","200")
)

# order levels
plot_df$Mutation <- factor(
  plot_df$Mutation,
  levels = c(
    "Phe167Tyr",

    "Glu198Ala",
    "Glu198Val",
    "Glu198Leu",
    "Glu198Lys",
    "Glu198Gly",

    "Phe200Tyr",

    "Susceptible"
  )
)

# plot
plot_5 <-
ggplot(plot_df,
       aes(x = Beta_codon,
           y = proportion,
           fill = Mutation)) +

  geom_col(width = 0.7) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0,1),
    expand = c(0,0)
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +

  labs(
    title = paste("plot_5:", sample_id),
    x = expression(beta*"-tubulin codon"),
    y = "Proportion of reads",
    fill = "Mutation"
  ) +

  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

plot_6: relative abundance of each specific resistance mutation (including 'undefined' mutations) vs susceptible alleles, at each codon position, per species, per sample
```{r}
# input csv
file <- "/Users/john.archer/Documents/Glasgow/anthelmogram/final_output_data/AHG_illumina_01/AHG_illumina_01_bt-i1_merged_FILTERED_FINAL.csv"

# define sample ID
sample_id <- "102"
df <- read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# filter to selected sample
df_s <- df %>%
  filter(grepl(paste0("^", sample_id, "\\."), Sample))

# keep one row per sample × species × codon
df_s <- df_s %>%
  group_by(Sample, Species, Beta_codon) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

# ensure numeric
df_s$Total_depth <- as.numeric(df_s$Total_depth)
df_s$Resistance_allele_frequency <- as.numeric(
  df_s$Resistance_allele_frequency
)
df_s$Susceptible_allele_frequency <- as.numeric(
  df_s$Susceptible_allele_frequency
)

# calculate species abundance
species_totals <- df_s %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(
    total_reads = sum(Total_depth),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    prop_species = total_reads / sum(total_reads)
  )

# filter species contributing <1% of reads
keep_species <- species_totals %>%
  filter(prop_species >= 0.01) %>%
  pull(Species)

df_s <- df_s %>%
  filter(Species %in% keep_species)

# define recognised resistance mutations
recognised_mutations <- c(
  "Phe167Tyr",

  "Glu198Ala",
  "Glu198Val",
  "Glu198Leu",
  "Glu198Lys",
  "Glu198Gly",

  "Phe200Tyr"
)

# define mutation category. NOTE: recognised mutations remain unchanged; NA values are treated as susceptible; any other mutation is classified as "undefined"
df_s <- df_s %>%
  mutate(
    Mutation = case_when(

      is.na(Protein_change_all) |
        Protein_change_all == "NA" |
        Protein_change_all == "" |
        Protein_change_all == "Susceptible"
      ~ "Susceptible",

      Protein_change_all %in% recognised_mutations
      ~ Protein_change_all,

      TRUE
      ~ "undefined"
    )
  )

# resistant allele abundance
df_resistant <- df_s %>%
  filter(Mutation != "Susceptible") %>%
  transmute(
    Species,
    Beta_codon,
    Mutation,
    abundance =
      Resistance_allele_frequency * Total_depth
  )

# susceptible allele abundance
df_susceptible <- df_s %>%
  transmute(
    Species,
    Beta_codon,
    Mutation = "Susceptible",
    abundance =
      Susceptible_allele_frequency * Total_depth
  )

# combine resistant and susceptible
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  df_susceptible,
  df_resistant
)

# sum abundance within each species × codon × mutation
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(
    Species,
    Beta_codon,
    Mutation
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    abundance = sum(abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# calculate proportions within each species × codon
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(
    Species,
    Beta_codon
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion =
      abundance / sum(abundance)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# order species by abundance
species_order <- species_totals %>%
  filter(Species %in% keep_species) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_reads)) %>%
  pull(Species)

plot_df$Species <- factor(
  plot_df$Species,
  levels = species_order
)

# order codons
plot_df$Beta_codon <- factor(
  plot_df$Beta_codon,
  levels = c(
    "codon167",
    "codon198",
    "codon200"
  ),
  labels = c(
    "167",
    "198",
    "200"
  )
)

# order mutation levels
plot_df$Mutation <- factor(
  plot_df$Mutation,
  levels = c(
    "Phe167Tyr",

    "Glu198Ala",
    "Glu198Val",
    "Glu198Leu",
    "Glu198Lys",
    "Glu198Gly",

    "Phe200Tyr",

    "undefined",

    "Susceptible"
  )
)

# plot
plot_6 <-
  ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
      x = Species,
      y = proportion,
      fill = Mutation
    )
  ) +

  geom_col(
    width = 0.8
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~Beta_codon,
    nrow = 1
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  theme_bw(
    base_size = 13
  ) +

  labs(
    title = paste(
      "plot_6:",
      sample_id
    ),
    x = "Nematode species",
    y = "Allele frequency",
    fill = "Mutation"
  ) +

  theme(
    axis.text.x =
      element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1
      ),
    panel.grid.minor =
      element_blank()
  )
```
